Name: AlwaysSpecialTitle
Author: DespairScent
Description:
With the release of 1.6, a special title animation was added to the game, which has a 2% chance of appearing when you click on the СoncernedApe logo.

This mod causes a special animation to always appear.

[url=https://github.com/DespairScent/AlwaysSpecialTitle]Source code[/url]

Manifest.Name: AlwaysSpecialTitle
Manifest.Description: Ensures that you encounter the special title screen when clicking at game startup
